Control Title: release署名とProvenanceを期待値に照合する
Control Summary: Artifact署名とSLSA provenanceをconsumer-owned signer、builder、source、build expectationへ照合する。
Check Title: Artifact digest matches the provenance subject
Threat Scenarios: RELEASE-FORGED-PROVENANCE: 攻撃者がartifactまたはprovenanceを差し替え、誤ったbuilderやsourceから生成されたreleaseを正規品として配布する。; RELEASE-TRUST-DOWNGRADE: 過去に署名・provenanceが存在したartifact familyで信頼signalが欠落または低下する。
Threat Actor or Source: attacker substituting an artifact while reusing unrelated valid provenance
Row Attack or Failure Scenario: downloaded bytes differ from the subject digest authenticated by provenance
Why This Check Is Required: signature validity alone does not bind evidence to the exact artifact being consumed
Expected Result: substituted artifacts and mismatched subjects are rejected
Framework Mappings: nist-ssdf 1.1 (SP 800-218, 2022) / PS.2.1 / supports / high; openssf-osps-baseline 2026.02.19 / OSPS-BR-06.01 / verifies / high; slsa 1.2 / build-l2#consumer-validates-authenticity / verifies / high; slsa 1.2 / build-provenance / verifies / high
Limitations: このfixtureはSLSA Build levelの正式assessmentまたはcomplianceを証明しない。; Keyless certificate、transparency log、revocation、timestamp検証は実環境adapterが必要である。; Trusted builderまたはsigning key自体の侵害は検出できない。; Crypto verifierの実行失敗をcleanな結果として扱ってはいけない。

Control Title: Release artifactとprovenanceを一対一で公開・配布する
Control Summary: Producerが各release artifactへdigest-bound provenanceをimmutableかつconsumer-accessibleな場所で同時公開し、保持とno-downgradeを検証する。
Check Title: Every release artifact has one digest-bound provenance object
Threat Scenarios: RELEASE-PROVENANCE-OMISSION: Release artifactだけが公開され、対応するprovenanceが欠落または別artifact向けのままconsumerへ配布される。; RELEASE-PROVENANCE-DISTRIBUTION-BYPASS: Provenanceがmutable、unauthenticated、非公開、発見不能な場所へ置かれ、consumerがartifactと一緒に取得できない。; RELEASE-PROVENANCE-DOWNGRADE: 過去にprovenanceを要求していたartifact familyで公開遅延、早期削除、または要件無効化が起きる。
Threat Actor or Source: release operator artifact substituter or faulty publication automation
Row Attack or Failure Scenario: an artifact is published without provenance with reused provenance or with evidence whose subject names different bytes
Why This Check Is Required: platform generation does not make evidence consumable until each distributed artifact has an unambiguous one-to-one digest-bound provenance reference
Required State: one unique provenance object per artifact with exact artifact SHA-256 subject binding and release-manifest discovery
Expected Result: duplicate missing orphaned mismatched and non-in-toto provenance records are rejected
Required Evidence: sanitized RPD-001 verifier result; release manifest with artifact and provenance digests
Framework Mappings: nist-ssdf 1.1 (SP 800-218, 2022) / PS.2.1 / supports / high; slsa 1.2 / build-l1#producer-distributes-provenance / verifies / high
Limitations: Fixtureはrelease APIとobject storageへ接続せず、production manifestとstorage inventoryを取得するread-only adapterが必要である。; URI、immutability、access、availabilityはsynthetic publication evidenceであり、TLS handshake、object lock、CDN cache、authorizationを独立検証しない。; Provenance content生成とplatform signer authenticityはPSB-BUILD-003、consumer側の署名・subject・builder expectation検証はPSB-REL-001が担当する。; 一年間のreference retentionは全productのsupport lifecycleや法的保存要件を満たすとは限らず、組織policyで延長する必要がある。; Public accessが不適切なprivate productではintended consumerのauthenticated access profileへ置き換え、credentialをmanifestへ埋め込んではならない。; このcontrolとSLSA mappingはSLSA Build Level 2達成またはcomplianceを単独で証明しない。
